headline: Under HEUR-S1 (Case A), only ~9.6 / 14.9 / 14.6 bits of Pwrong underestimation suffice to push Carrier CC Kyber-512/768/1024 costs to the NIST classical cutoffs 143/207/272 — comparable to or far below the ~84-bit Fig 4.1→Kyber512 floor gap isolated in KN-FIND-012.
findings: Under HEUR-S1 (Case A), only ~9.6 / 14.9 / 14.6 bits of Pwrong underestimation suffice to push Carrier CC Kyber-512/768/1024 costs to the NIST classical cutoffs 143/207/272 — comparable to or far below the ~84-bit Fig 4.1→Kyber512 floor gap isolated in KN-FIND-012.
This is conditional on HEUR-S1; it is not a corrected Carrier cost and not an ML-KEM break.
Together with KN-FIND-012, it shows the CC shortfalls are brittle to modest Pwrong model error once the second term must pay for ε restoration.
